payload.answer: Keep all five. The per-layer gates are not made redundant by the total -- they carry ATTRIBUTION. A failing total gate says 'something regressed'; a failing 'Gate 4c - pytest infrastructure layer' says which layer, which is what makes the failure actionable at a glance. There is also a hard mechanical reason: the existing CI step names are matched by branch protection rules, so removing or renaming them breaks merge requirements. The total gate is an additional step, never a replacement.
